normalization.gain_formula: gain_raw = target_p90 / P90_raw; gain_used = clip(gain_raw, gain_min, gain_max)
normalization.rounding: nearest integer, ties to even (numpy.rint), after float64 multiplication
normalization.invalid_statistic_policy: If P90_raw <= 0, preserve a raw copy and record INVALID_REFERENCE_STATISTIC

qc.warning_comparison: strictly greater than each threshold; nested warnings are cumulative

provenance.selection: Reference image explicitly selected by the user; reference-90% preview accepted after human visual review
provenance.preview_dataset: 211 previously extracted early frames, selected using a uniform 3% frame-position rule
provenance.validation_scope: Observed results for this preview dataset only; not a permanent algorithm performance guarantee
provenance.gain_bounds: Accepted preview bounds are fixed in this preset; do not recompute them for a new dataset
provenance.reference_storage: External image data; filename and SHA-256 identify the reference without bundling it in Git
